instruction:
RF Front-End Chain Along a Straight Line

The file /home/user/Desktop/design.kicad_pcb contains a PCB with 8 RF chain components (U1=ANT, U2=LNA, U3=BPF, U4=MIX, U5=AMP, U6=LPF, U7=ADC, U8=DAQ) placed randomly. These components form a signal chain in the listed order.

Reposition all 8 components along a straight horizontal line in signal order and write the result as /home/user/Desktop/design.kicad_pcb.

Requirements:
1. All 8 components must be placed such that all their Y coordinates are within +/-0.5 mm of the mean Y of the group.
2. X coordinates must be strictly increasing in signal order (U1 leftmost, U8 rightmost).
3. Centre-to-centre spacing between adjacent components must be at least 6 mm.
4. All rotation angles must be multiples of 90 deg.
5. No component may be rotated exactly 180 deg (connector polarity preservation).
6. No component may be added or removed.

Write /home/user/Desktop/design.kicad_pcb.
source: TI / Analog Devices / Nordic / Microchip PCB layout app notes (TI LMH5401 eval-board RF layout), Henry Ott, *Electromagnetic Compatibility Engineering* ch. 11
